comment: WP-6.4: the button bindings that used to live here as MapButtonToLogical have
moved to models/nogame.bindings.json, and the descriptions with them.
They MOVED rather than being duplicated. Leaving them here as a fallback looks
safer and is not: the new table would answer for a rebound key while this one
still answered for the original, so rebinding would add a control instead of
replacing it - the old key would keep firing forever.
The MapButtonToLogical property itself is retained on the class. It is public
API, it still works, and a game that has not migrated can still use it; the new
WP-6.4 part 2: the same file now also carries the ANALOG bindings that used to be
hardcoded in InputController - walkforward/backward/left/right, move, look, brake
and accelerate - together with the response curves that were written as arithmetic
